messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

I pulled it up. Your Magic Miner 40T on Shop····, with the Miner Duster and Power Kit, is paid and still hasn't shipped. The October 31 date we gave you has just passed, and I'm sorry about that. The warehouse is still waiting on the Wave 1 units to be checked in, so I won't give you a date I can't stand behind.

You can watch that batch land here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking goes to (email hidden) the moment the label prints. Want me to ask the team for a firm date?
